passages.quote:
sbestos safety in the workplace

Employers should follow the Health and Safety Executive’s guidance on the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 and management of asbestos in workplace settings.

Read managing and working with asbestos - HSE website

If you are in Northern Ireland, refer to the Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland’s website: Home - Health and Safety Executive for Northern Ireland, controlling risk together

Early years settings and schools

Schools and early years providers are asked to follow the guidance for consumers above on identifying affected products and the correct disposal guidance for their setting.

About this guidance

This guidance has been developed jointly by the Office for Product Safety and Standards (OPSS) in DBT, the Health and Safety Executive (HSE), the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra), the Department for Education (DfE), the Environment Agency (EA), the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs NI (DAERA), the Natural Resources Body for Wales (NRW), the Scottish Government, the Scottish Environment Protection Agency (SEPA), and the Welsh Government. It reflects a coordinated cross-government response and should be read alongside any organisation-specific guidance referenced throughout this page.
